memory_candidates.content: When writing a scratch-repo test fixture for a Containment-style predicate (a path tested against a task's own declared scope), do not use a path inside the task's OWN fixture directory as the 'out of scope' negative candidate -- the dispatching task's own resolved directory is typically an unconditional implicit scope member by design, so nothing inside it can ever be classified out-of-scope. Use a path under a genuinely separate sibling directory instead (e.g. a second fixture task directory).

verify-deploy.sh's TARGET_REPO positional argument must be a repo ROOT that carries a real deployed .claude/ tree, never the agent-system/ source-store subdirectory itself (which has no .claude/ and errors 'no deploy tree'). When invoking it from within the source-store repo for a source-store-only change, pass '.' (the repo root) as TARGET_REPO, not 'agent-system'.

validate-no-task-references.sh's write-time PreToolUse hook inspects only the Edit tool call's own new_string in isolation -- it cannot see a surrounding task-ref-ok:begin/end marker already present elsewhere in the file (even one written moments earlier in the same session). When adding more fixture content containing legitimate synthetic --task N literals inside an already-marker-wrapped region, write the content via Bash/a script (python/sed) instead of the Edit tool, since Bash writes are not subject to that same hook.
